commands_run: cargo fmt --all 2>&1; cargo fmt --all --check 2>&1; cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings 2>&1
cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-agent fake 2>&1
cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test drain > drain.log 2>&1; ls -la drain.log
cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test drain > drain.log 2>&1; ls -la drain.log
cargo fmt --all && cargo test --locked > full_test.log 2>&1; ls -la full_test.log
rm -f full_test.log drain.log; cargo fmt --all --check 2>&1; cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings 2>&1; cargo test -p xtask --test policy 2>&1; ls crates/athena-cli/tests/mirrors.rs
cargo test -p athena-cli --test mirrors 2>&1; git status --short
cargo test -p athena-core request_coverage 2>&1; cargo test -p athena-core --test refusal_corpus 2>&1; cargo fmt --all --check

policy_denials.detail: git status --short | head; wc -l crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs crates/athena-core/src/reading/*.rs crates/athena-core/tests/refusal_corpus.rs; sed -n 440,560p crates/athena-core/src/reading/checks.rs

sed -n 1,40p crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs; grep -n "^mod \|^pub use\|^use \|fn reading_source" crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs | head -50; sed -n 100,160p crates/athena-core/src/reading/outcome.rs; sed -n 255,290p crates/athena-core/src/reading/topics.rs
cargo fmt --all 2>&1; cargo fmt --all --check 2>&1 && echo FMT_OK; cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings 2>&1
cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-agent fake 2>&1 | tail -n 15
